headline: In 2027 Ukraine needs over another $32.6 billion in external budget financing – Koretskyi
summary: Ukraine's 2027 external budget financing need exceeds $52 billion, of which almost $20 billion has been secured, leaving over $32.6 billion (EUR 30 billion) still to be raised, PM Serhiy Koretskyi reported.
why: External budget financing from donors and international lenders is essential for Ukraine's state budget, affecting its sovereign credit and reconstruction funding.
